items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I was called by all of us. Me, Laurie, Butscott, whether he was in Washington.

ctx.x: I wonder what that music is now. Those arrangements. I sure would like to fight. Ooh.

He really had some nice arrangements too. And he come, he had a lot of stuff. We went down to, down to publish it. I used to go with him. Went down in there. Come back with a home full of stuff. He got sick. What was the matter with him? Oh, he, I think he had heart, he had heart trouble. He'd get short of the breath, you know, all that could make it. So, he went to hospital. It was all. I was called by all of us. Me, Laurie, Butscott, whether he was in Washington. Did he make his own arrangements? Oh, yeah,…
When you first started, did you play in little street bands, like little skiffle bands, and so on? I played with three pieces.
